courses.summary: 以歷史錫礦的持續水處理為案例，研究地下水、污泥回流和長期驗收。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: A historic tin-mine water-treatment case examines groundwater, sludge recycling and long-term performance acceptance. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
